messages:
Maya R: CI is red on linux-integration-02 — failing test runtime/heap_manager_test::race_on_cleanup. Seen it twice in CI, can't reproduce 100% locally but hit it with stress runs. Any quick suggestions?

Owen T: can you paste the failing stdout/snippet? link to the build?

CI Bot: Build #4128 failed — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4128

Maya R: log:
```
[ RUN      ] heap_manager_test.race_on_cleanup
heap_manager.cc:472] double-free detected in background cleanup
terminate called without an active exception
[  FAILED  ] heap_manager_test.race_on_cleanup (23 ms)
```

Liam H: oof double-free. Related to the deferred cleanup queue maybe. Was there a recent change to deferred_cleanup ordering? Noor S merged one last week that added randomization to avoid starvation.

Noor S: yep that was my CL (PR #2893). It added jitter to the worker sleep to spread out cleanup. I tested locally but not under heavy parallelism. Could be exposing a race.

Owen T: can you run with ASAN/UBSAN on CI? or at least add --gtest_repeat=100 to try to reproduce. Also try setting REDWOOD_DEFERRED_CLEANUP=0 to force immediate cleanup.

Maya R: starting a rerun with ASAN (it's heavy, but worth it). CMD I used for local stress:
```
./build/tests/heap_manager_test --gtest_filter=heap_manager_test.race_on_cleanup --gtest_repeat=100
```

CI Bot: Rerun requested by Maya R — queued as job 4130

Liam H: If it's non-deterministic we should bisect. Owen, can you do a quick git bisect between v2.1.4 and HEAD? I can help write a reproducible harness.

Owen T: i can take bisect. Need a reliable script that returns exit 0 on success/failure. Maya can you add a tiny wrapper that runs the test once under the environment that reproduced? Put it in tools/bisect/heap_repro.sh

Maya R: will do. quick question — is it better to bisect the PR range that touched deferred cleanup (2890..2896) or the entire main history? Might be faster to limit to those PRs.

Noor S: start narrow with PR range, if that fails expand. My change is PR #2893, so start +/- a few commits.

Owen T: agreed. I'll kick off bisect tomorrow morning and post updates here. If someone gets a clean repro under ASAN, post stack trace so we can link to suspect lines.

Liam H: also add `--gtest_shuffle=1 --gtest_random_seed=XXXXX` in the wrapper so bisect can vary seed; might make intermittent ordering issues surface systematically.

Maya R: noted. thanks — will push wrapper and a small CI job that runs it nightly until we fix. :thumbsup:

CI Bot: Job 4130 completed — failed on first run with ASAN report uploaded: https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/4130/asan.txt

Owen T: grabbing ASAN now. Thanks all.

Noor S: ping me when bisect narrows to a suspect commit, I can revert or patch a fix quickly.

Maya R: thanks team. I'll paste the bisect command here when I have the wrapper: `git bisect start -- bad HEAD --good v2.1.4 && git bisect run tools/bisect/heap_repro.sh` :eyes:

Liam H: :rocket:
